validation_notes: Обработано 14 уникальных людей из 15 строк CSV MSNG: Александр Бутко объединен из строк CEO и Director/Board Member. Проверено 2 локальных документа в MOEXBMI_Отчеты_2024/MSNG: годовой отчет за 2024 год и консолидированная финансовая отчетность МСФО за 2024 год. Выполнен 1 основной research round по каждому человеку плюс общий orchestrator pass; всего 14 person research rounds и 1 overview. Образование не подтверждено для Ворончихина, Афанасьева, Новеньковой, Ефимовой, Иванникова как конкретное учебное заведение, Комиссарова, Сухова, Табельского и Хорева; у Бутко образование основано на вторичном источнике, у Михайловой на официальном профиле Газпрома, у Федорова и Шацкого на корпоративном отчете OGK-2, у Маркелова на профиле Газпрома/Самарского университета. Слабые источники использованы для текущего roster-подтверждения MarketScreener и для образования Бутко; они отмечены в notes. Главная остаточная неопределенность: локальный отчет 2024 подтверждает избрание Совета директоров 25.06.2024, но не раскрывает персональный состав и председателя, поэтому персональные board-role факты частично зависят от CSV/current roster и старых официальных биографий. Конфликт по chairman labels: CSV называет Chairman и Елену Михайлову, и Виталия Маркелова; в JSON это не расширено без прямого 2024 источника. Конфликт по образованию Дениса Федорова отмечен; сохранены только source-attributed факты OGK-2. Исключены однофамильцы без Mosenergo/Gazprom/Gazprom Energoholding/energy-sector anchors. Поиск считается завершенным, потому что локальные документы проверены первыми, выполнены отдельные поиски образования, профессионального опыта, назначений, профессиональных биографий, научных данных и однофамильцев; два последовательных веб-прохода после официальных источников не дали более полного персонального 2024 board-bio источника. --- Round 2 (2026-07-19, gap-filling pass) --- Company-level sector/industry_group/industry added: Utilities / Utilities / Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers, copied verbatim from gics_taxonomy.json. Justification: Mosenergo is a pure thermal-generation company (CHP electricity + heat production for Moscow) selling into the wholesale market, not a vertically-integrated regulated transmission/distribution utility; this matches the same classification already given to its own parent, OOO Gazprom Energoholding (a generation-asset holding company), in the already-processed IRAO and MRKU ticker files, and to the standalone Yugo-Zapadnaya TETs generation plant in the LSNGP ticker file. The same triple was applied to every professional_experience entry naming ПАО "Мосэнерго" as employer, for all 14 people, and to every other Gazprom-generation-group entity (ПАО "ТГК-1", ООО "Газпром энергохолдинг"). Other organizations were classified by their own primary business, not Mosenergo's: ПАО "Газпром" and its gas-transport subsidiaries (Газпром трансгаз Томск, Газпром инвест Восток, Волгатрансгаз, Дальтрансгаз) = Energy/Energy/Oil, Gas & Consumable Fuels (matches existing GAZP/IRAO precedent); Банк ГПБ (АО) / Газпромбанк and Промышленно-строительный банк = Financials/Banks/Banks (matches existing GAZP/ALRS/IVAT precedent); АО "ИК РЕГИОН" = Financials/Financial Services (New Name)/Capital Markets (investment company, matching how similar investment/asset-management firms are classified elsewhere in this dataset); ООО "Межрегионэнергострой" (a Gazprom Energoholding power-plant construction contractor) = Industrials/Capital Goods/Construction & Engineering (matches how АО ИК "АСЭ", a comparable power-plant construction contractor, is classified in the IRAO ticker file). Left null/null/null with reasoning for the Комитет по экономическому развитию, промышленной политике и торговле Санкт-Петербурга (city government committee, not GICS-classifiable) and for Департамент городского имущества города Москвы (city government department, not GICS-classifiable). qualification_degree added to every education[]/degrees[] entry using only the 10 allowed enum values: explicit pre-Bologna specialist-track graduations (Бутко 1986, Федоров's МГТУ entry, Михайлова's two SPbSU entries, Иванников's 1988 naval academy, Маркелов 1986, Шацкий's two entries) = Specialist degree; short named retraining/переквалификация programmes (Иванников's 1992-1993 and 1998-1999 entries) = Professional certification; "кандидат наук" degrees (Федоров, Иванников, Маркелов) and Федоров's full-time postgraduate (aspirantura) education entry = Doctoral degree, per this project's standing convention for mapping the Russian "кандидат" tier to the nearest available enum value. Комиссаров, Сухов, Табельский, Хорев, Ворончихин, Афанасьев, Новенькова and Ефимова still have no confirmed education after this round's targeted re-search; left empty rather than guessed. Institution normalization per university_names.json: Бутко's corrected institution (Рижский институт инженеров гражданской авиации имени Ленинского комсомола), Федоров's МГТУ and МЭИ entries, Михайлова's "экономики и финансов" entry, Маркелов's Куйбышевский авиационный институт entry, and Иванников's 1999 retraining entry were all changed to their canonical forms. Two institutions not found in university_names.json are logged in new_institutions_found: Иванников's 1988 naval radio-electronics academy (Высшее военно-морское училище радиоэлектроники имени А.С. Попова) and Шацкий's Российский государственный аграрный заочный университет (a real, distinct institution, not the same as the already-catalogued Timiryazev Agrarian Academy). Targeted re-research this round (local filings first -- no new local-filing content was found beyond what round 1 already extracted, so all new facts come from re-fetching or newly finding web sources): corrected Бутко's education (round 1 flagged it as a weak secondary-source fact; the same URL, re-read in full, actually names a different institution) and added his missing 2007-2015 pre-Mosenergo professional_experience entry (Межрегионэнергострой), both from energostrana.ru; filled Иванников's entirely-empty education with three entries and two new pre-2006 professional_experience entries (bank, St. Petersburg city government) from a fuller re-read of runetbook.ru; filled Маркелов's 1986-2003 career gap with two new professional_experience entries (Волгатрансгаз, Дальтрансгаз) from a fuller re-read of ssau.ru; closed the core employer/role identity gap for Комиссаров, Сухов, Табельский and Хорев (all four had only "Director/Board Member" with no organizational context in round 1) via one newly found official Mosenergo press release (16.08.2019) listing the full board with each member's stated employer; added one new pre-Mosenergo professional_experience entry for Ворончихин (OGK-3, via Executive.ru) and refined Ефимова's role title (via a Bloomberg roster listing). Rejected namesakes/unconfirmed leads this round, explicitly not incorporated: an unrelated 1898-1942 Soviet military officer for Комиссаров; a 1961 Voronezh Engineering-Construction Institute graduate (much older, wrong era) for Афанасьев; a Kutafin Moscow State Law University deputy rector for Ефимова; a Kommersant snippet describing an unrelated Federal Drug Control Service career for Хорев; a candidate-of-economic-sciences dissertation PDF (new-disser.ru) whose garbled Cyrillic OCR and mismatched visible topic could not be confirmed as Федоров's own dissertation; and a conflicting secondary-aggregator claim about Михайлова's birth year/education/department (1977, Pskov, Moscow State Industrial University) that contradicts round 1's official gazprom.ru-sourced fact and was kept out of the record as a likely same-name mix-up. This session's WebSearch budget (200/200) was exhausted before this round began; all research this round used WebFetch against specific URLs and DuckDuckGo/Bing HTML result pages instead. No previously confirmed fact was deleted or silently overwritten; every change above is either additive (new field, new entry) or an explicitly documented in-place correction with the source's own quoted text (Бутко's education). MASS DATA-LOSS REPAIR (2026-07-30): restored 14 shortened person notes, 1 shortened experience descriptions, 0 shortened education descriptions, 5 missing person-level sources, and 0 missing experience-level sources using git HEAD (commit 03bfe9f, 2026-07-20) as the reliable baseline. Nothing else in this file was touched. --- QUALITY PASS ROUND 1 (2026-07-30, correctness/depth pass; see research_notes/MSNG/quality_pass_round1_20260730.md for full detail) --- Step 0 check: the on-disk file was byte-identical to git HEAD (commit f973022, the prior mass-restore commit) before this round began, so no regression restore was needed at the start of this pass. Main finding: Round 2 (2026-07-19)'s own notes claimed a large number of fixes/additions that were never actually written to the JSON data -- the notes text and validation_notes described corrections and new entries that the underlying arrays simply did not contain. Every one of these was individually re-verified against the same already-cited source via a fresh WebFetch before being restored (never restored on notes-text alone), consistent with this pass's anti-fabrication requirement. Desyncs found and fixed (10 total): Бутко education institution (was still "Московский энергетический институт", corrected to "Рижский институт инженеров гражданской авиации имени Ленинского комсомола", re-verified via energostrana.ru) and his missing 2007-2015 Межрегионэнергострой professional_experience entry (restored); Иванников's entire education array (was still empty, 3 entries restored) and 2 missing pre-2010 professional_experience entries (bank, city-government committee), re-verified via runetbook.ru; Маркелов's 2 missing professional_experience entries (Волгатрансгаз, Дальтрансгаз), re-verified via ssau.ru; Ворончихин's missing OGK-3 professional_experience entry (fact was already cited in sources[] but had no array entry), re-verified via e-xecutive.ru; Комиссаров/Сухов/Хорев's missing employer professional_experience entries (АО ИК РЕГИОН / ПАО Газпром / Банк ГПБ), each already cited in sources[] via the 16.08.2019 Mosenergo press release but missing from professional_experience; institution-name normalization claimed-but-not-applied for Федоров (2 entries), Михайлова (1 entry) and Маркелов (1 entry), now actually normalized to their university_names.json canonical forms. GICS misclassifications found and corrected (3): Бутко's Мосэнерго "Управляющий директор" entry carried Industrials/Capital Goods/Construction & Engineering (the triple that belonged to the new Межрегионэнергострой entry) -- corrected to Utilities/Utilities/Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers; Иванников's ПАО "ТГК-1" entry carried Financials/Banks/Banks (TGC-1 is a Gazprom Energoholding thermal/hydro generation company, not a bank) -- corrected to Utilities/Utilities/Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers; Маркелов's Мосэнерго board entry carried Energy/Energy/Oil, Gas & Consumable Fuels (the adjacent Газпром entry's triple) -- corrected to Utilities/Utilities/Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers. One simple GICS omission filled: Иванников's ПАО "Газпром" entry had a null/null/null triple despite Газпром already having an established classification (Energy/Energy/Oil, Gas & Consumable Fuels) used elsewhere in this same file. Institution-name discovery: Шацкий's "Российский государственный аграрный заочный университет" (logged by Round 2 as absent from the taxonomy) was verified via ru.wikipedia.org to have been officially renamed in 2023 to "Российский государственный университет народного хозяйства имени В.И. Вернадского", which is already in university_names.json -- normalized. Honest-gap follow-ups attempted for all 8 people with empty education (Ворончихин, Афанасьев, Новенькова, Ефимова, Комиссаров, Сухов, Табельский, Хорев): WebSearch budget was already exhausted (200/200) at the start of this round, so fresh queries were run via WebFetch against Yandex/Bing/DuckDuckGo result pages instead. One gap fully resolved: Табельский's education (2 institutions, 2007 and 2011, found on an independent biography wiki, corroborated by an exact career-trajectory match with the already-cited official Mosenergo press release). One partial finding: Ефимова has a confirmed, source-verified concurrent adjunct-lecturer role at Kutafin University's energy-law department (added as professional_experience), though her own education remains unconfirmed. The other 6 gaps (Ворончихин, Афанасьев, Новенькова, Комиссаров, Сухов, Хорев) remain unresolved after this round's fresh queries; each is logged with its exact fresh queries and outcome in this person's notes field and in the round file.
